short: Diffusion decoder with per-frame MP-FiLM (M06) and audio-only pretraining (M02) are standard; quality and speaker-similarity leads rest on enhanced targets and a clean-reference enrollment.
position: LipDiffuser [@richter2025lipdiffuser] changes the decoder (M06), conditioning a magnitude-preserving diffusion denoiser on video frame by frame, and the training targets (M02), with audio-only pretraining and enhanced LRS3 audio; neither change is ablated, and audio-only pretraining was already tested, with mixed effect, by Kefalas et al. [@kefalas2023audio], so both are standard. Its quality lead rests on predictors that place it level with the clean recordings (DNSMOS above, NISQA below), and its speaker-similarity lead on an enrollment taken from the clean reference, an advantage that V2SFlow [@choi2024v2sflow] shows changes speaker similarity but not WER; on WER it does not beat LipVoicer or IL2S (SSL).
